notes: PARENT FIELD INCOMPLETE — REPRESENTS TWO PEOPLE, NOT ONE (research 2026-07-03): this tree treats 'Abigail (Hyde) Stowell' as the sole parent of Isaac Stowell Jr. (I182541959366), but the maiden-name-in-parens notation is being read as if it were the complete parent field, omitting the father entirely. Per a WikiTree/FamilySearch-derived compiled summary and the 'Stowell Family History' compilation (Grand Lake Historical Society, citing the 1922 Stowell genealogy), Isaac Stowell Jr.'s parents were Isaac Stowell Sr. (b. 1708, Newton, son of Israel Stowell and Abigail Fuller) and this woman, Abigail Hyde (daughter of Jonathan Hyde and Hannah (Dana) Hyde of Newton), married 17 Feb 1731/32 at Newton. Isaac Stowell Sr. does not exist as a separate person-record in this tree.
